description: This file contains utility functions for network interface management, including creating, configuring, and destroying network interfaces, bridges, and related resources within the Android Cuttlefish project. It interacts with system commands to control network devices such as tap interfaces, bridges, and iptables, and includes functions for setting up DHCP and DNS configurations.

methods.name: int RunExternalCommand(const std::string & command)
methods.description: Executes an external system command and returns its exit status.

methods.name: bool AddTapIface(const std::string & name)
methods.description: Creates a tap interface using system commands.

methods.name: bool ShutdownIface(const std::string & name)
methods.description: Sets a network interface down.

methods.name: bool BringUpIface(const std::string & name)
methods.description: Brings a network interface up.

methods.name: bool CreateEthernetIface(const std::string & name,const std::string & bridge_name,bool has_ipv4_bridge,bool has_ipv6_bridge,bool use_ebtables_legacy)
methods.description: Creates and configures an Ethernet interface with optional bridge and IP settings.

methods.name: std::string MobileGatewayName(const std::string & ipaddr,uint16_t id)
methods.description: Generates a mobile gateway IP address based on input IP and ID.

methods.name: std::string MobileNetworkName(const std::string & ipaddr,const std::string & netmask,uint16_t id)
methods.description: Generates a mobile network IP/mask address based on input IP, netmask, and ID.

methods.name: bool CreateMobileIface(const std::string & name,uint16_t id,const std::string & ipaddr)
methods.description: Creates a mobile network interface with associated gateway and IP configuration.

methods.name: bool DestroyMobileIface(const std::string & name,uint16_t id,const std::string & ipaddr)
methods.description: Removes a mobile network interface and cleans up relevant configurations.

methods.name: bool AddGateway(const std::string & name,const std::string & gateway,const std::string & netmask)
methods.description: Adds an IP address as a gateway to a network interface.

methods.name: bool DestroyGateway(const std::string & name,const std::string & gateway,const std::string & netmask)
methods.description: Removes the gateway IP address from a network interface.

methods.name: bool DestroyEthernetIface(const std::string & name,bool has_ipv4_bridge,bool has_ipv6_bridge,bool use_ebtables_legacy)
methods.description: Destroys an Ethernet interface and related configurations.

methods.name: bool CreateEbtables(const std::string & name,bool use_ipv4,bool use_ebtables_legacy)
methods.description: Sets up ebtables rules for bridging.

methods.name: bool DestroyEbtables(const std::string & name,bool use_ipv4,bool use_ebtables_legacy)
methods.description: Removes ebtables rules for bridging.

methods.name: bool EbtablesBroute(const std::string & name,bool use_ipv4,bool add,bool use_ebtables_legacy)
methods.description: Configures ebtables broute chain for network filtering.

methods.name: bool EbtablesFilter(const std::string & name,bool use_ipv4,bool add,bool use_ebtables_legacy)
methods.description: Configures ebtables filter chain for network filtering.

methods.name: bool LinkTapToBridge(const std::string & tap_name,const std::string & bridge_name)
methods.description: Links a tap interface to a bridge.

methods.name: bool CreateTap(const std::string & name)
methods.description: Creates and initializes a tap interface.

methods.name: bool DeleteIface(const std::string & name)

methods.name: bool DestroyIface(const std::string & name)
methods.description: Shuts down and deletes a network interface.

methods.name: std::optional<std::string> GetUserName(uid_t uid)
methods.description: Retrieves the username associated with a user ID.
